Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00<br>
<br>
[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings]<br>
"PauseFeatureUpdatesStartTime"="2022-09-30T10:23:59Z"<br>
"PauseFeatureUpdatesEndTime"="3000-12-31T10:23:59Z"<br>
"PauseQualityUpdatesStartTime"="2022-09-30T10:23:59Z"<br>
"PauseQualityUpdatesEndTime"="3000-12-31T10:23:59Z"<br>
"PauseUpdatesStartTime"="2022-09-30T10:23:59Z"<br>
"PauseUpdatesExpiryTime"="3000-12-31T10:23:59Z"<br>
<br>
把上内容复制到记事本，另存为随便名.reg格式，然后合并即可<img src="https://static.52pojie.cn/static/image/smiley/default/53.gif" smilieid="933" border="0" alt=""></td></tr></tbody></table>
